typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	totblCalypsoMarkitWireExceptionsSWContractState_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		TRADE_ID as decimal(38,0),
		KEYWORD_NAME as string,
		KEYWORD_VALUE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> fromTRADEKEYWORD
fromTRADEKEYWORD derive({Copy of KEYWORD_NAME} = KEYWORD_NAME,
		{Copy of TRADE_ID} = toString(TRADE_ID),
		{Copy of KEYWORD_VALUE} = KEYWORD_VALUE) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		Keyword_Value as string,
		Keyword_Name as string,
		Trade_Id as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Keyword_Value = {Copy of KEYWORD_VALUE},
		Keyword_Name = {Copy of KEYWORD_NAME},
		Trade_Id = {Copy of TRADE_ID}),
	partitionFileNames:[($totblCalypsoMarkitWireExceptionsSWContractState_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> totblCalypsoMarkitWireExceptionsSWContractState
